subject: PINNED P0: 103 server-graded quizzes/exams mark every answer wrong (missing .data unwrap)
description: ROOT CAUSE: FirebaseAuth.callFunction returns the raw callable result {data:...}, but 103 hand-rolled per-question grading pages read `r.results` directly instead of `r.data.results` -> undefined -> gradeOne returns false -> EVERY answer marked Incorrect for EVERY student. Introduced commit dbec80aee (2026-07-02, partial-flag per-question grading). QuizEngine.js + aplus-core1-prep quizzes are CORRECT (they unwrap .data). Fix is identical across all: `.then(function(r){ var d=(r&&r.data)?r.data:r; return !!(d&&d.results&&d.results[qIndex]&&d.results[qIndex].correct); })`. Full file list: scratchpad/broken-grading.txt (103 files: cr-*, fl-*, cb-*, sr-*, bm-*, pis-*, csp-*, cse-*, eth-*, sp-*, pfi-*, ra-*, ala-w*). bm-midterm fixed as exemplar 2026-07-17.
